steps: Sign up to drive with Uber (eligible car, insurance, background check).
Go online in the Driver app and accept ride requests; fares + promotions + tips show in the app.
Complete trips; earnings accrue in your driver balance.
Add a debit card to unlock Instant Pay after your first trip.
Cash out up to 6 times per day ($1.25 each; free and automatic after every trip with the Uber Pro Card).
timing: Instant Pay: up to 6x/day to your debit card ($1.25 each), cash usually right away. Uber Pro Card: free automatic payout after every trip.
who_pays: Uber pays you per trip — fares plus promotions, quests, and surge plus tips; trip earnings are shown before you accept.
who_qualifies: 21+ in most US markets for rideshare; an eligible 4-door vehicle plus insurance; a background check; a debit card for Instant Pay.
work_available: Open once you're approved — you go online and take rides; demand varies by market and time of day. Rideshare requirements are stricter than delivery (car, insurance, age minimums).
what_gets_accepted: Trips pay the offered fare with promotions and surge on top. Your real costs (gas, maintenance, depreciation, insurance) come out of whatever the trip pays — Uber quotes fares, not profit.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees to join. Unpaid time: waiting between trips, plus the application and background check. Vehicle costs are yours; Instant Pay costs $1.25 per cashout (free automatic payout with the Uber Pro Card).
when_cash_arrives: Instant Pay: up to 6 cashouts a day to your debit card ($1.25 each), cash usually right away. Uber Pro Card: free automatic payout after every trip.

repeatable.cadence: Drive whenever you want — each trip earns, cash out up to 6x a day with Instant Pay, and keep driving.
